about: Answer key for the keyed empty-column pages vacancy-v1 (queue #114, W10b, hypothesis H12 in ~/design-lab/homepage-workflow/HYPOTHESES.md). Each page holds one empty-column run that the unchanged page check finds (runs listed from a capture with origin/master 19e24046's design_capture.py --page-checks, desktop 1280x800, host headless browser). 'answer' and 'reason' come from how each page was built, under the vacancy rule Design (home) decided before any code (docs/design.md, 'Empty-column vacancy'). Keyed and sealed (~/design-lab/seals/vacancy-v1.json) before the vacancy code was written. A mismatch is explained in ~/design-lab/homepage-workflow/wave2/W10b-REPORT.md and fixed in the measurement, never by editing this key; a new hold-out page tests the fix.
rule: yes (vacant): vacant_track, trailing or orphan; no: in_item, between, block, and the two reasons this build added, below_bar (the run lies over a track no item is placed in but covers under track_cover of it) and outside_items (any other no). Thresholds: track_cover 0.5, set_size_tolerance 0.10.

runs.why: Three equal tracks (repeat(3, 1fr)) and one card: tracks 2 and 3 hold no item, and the run covers both.
Seven equal cards in three tracks: the seventh sits alone in its row, its set sits three abreast above, and the run is two cards wide. Every track holds an item, so not vacant_track.

Five cards in a wrapping flex row, three a row: the second row ends after two cards; no item of that row overlaps the run and the run reaches the row's end edge. Trailing, not orphan: the fifth card shares its row with the fourth, so it is not lone.
Hero grid of two equal tracks with its picture item removed: track 2 holds no item and the run covers all of it.
Hero flex row with its picture item removed: the copy is the row's only item, its lines end before the run, and the run reaches the row's end edge.
Three tracks with items placed in tracks 1 and 3 only: track 2 holds no item and the run covers it.

2fr/3fr grid: a wrapper holding the heading and intro beside a list of questions. The run is the label column under the short label, in the label item's x-range: a column that ends early (the standard offset FAQ layout).
The h2 and p are direct grid items in track 1 and the dl spans the rows in track 2: the run lies in the x-range of the heading and intro.
As label-wrapper, with the label held by position: sticky and align-self: start: the run lies in the label item's x-range.

1fr/1fr: the label in track 1 row 1 and the FAQ cards one per row in track 2. The run lies under the label, in its x-range. The cards are never two abreast, so the lone cards beside the run are no orphans.
A short pitch beside a tall form card: the run lies in the pitch item's x-range (the pitch ends early).
Copy beside a picture shorter than the copy: the run lies under the picture, in the picture item's x-range.
Stacked label and control rows, each its own flex row with space-between: no row box holds the run's height, and the list around the rows is block flow.
Running text held to a 560 px measure in plain block flow: no grid or flex container.
Seven 400 px cards in three tracks (align-items: start); the lone seventh is 436 px tall, 9% from its siblings, within 10%: still a member of the set.
The lone seventh card is 444 px tall, 11% from its siblings, outside 10%: no set, so no orphan. The run lies in the x-range of the cards above it in tracks 2 and 3.
Tracks 320 px and 800 px; the only item is placed in track 1 and overflows 360 px (45%) into track 2, where no item is placed: the run covers 440 of 800 px (55%), at least half.

The same with the item overflowing 440 px (55%) into track 2: the run covers 360 of 800 px (45%), under half. No decided no reason fits (no item beside it on the right, not block flow), so the added reason below_bar.
Added by this build. Two content-sized grid tracks spread to the frame's ends (justify-content: space-between): the run is the spread space between the two items.

Added by this build. Two flex items spread with space-between: no item overlaps the run, but the run does not reach the row's end edge (the second item is there), so not trailing; it lies between the items.
Added by this build. A grid with one track (minmax(0, 560px)) of text items: a one-column container.
